subject.title: typedocs-only PR to help others avoid kubernetes OOM-kills

question: Should the shared Kubernetes manifest ship a fixed `NODE_OPTIONS` heap cap by default, or should this stay optional operator guidance?
rationale: A fixed default can improve the reported setup but becomes an inherited operator setting with upgrade and tuning impact, so maintainers need to own that tradeoff after the wording and proof gaps are fixed.

options.title: Accept fixed default after proof
options.body: Require corrected Node/cgroup wording plus redacted Kubernetes proof, then intentionally ship the fixed heap cap in the shared manifest.

options.title: Make it optional guidance
options.body: Keep the documentation about when to set `NODE_OPTIONS`, but avoid changing the default manifest for every Kubernetes user.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: If the fixed cap is too prescriptive and the proof remains missing, leave the branch paused until a narrower proposal arrives.

recommendation.title: Accept fixed default after proof
recommendation.body: Require corrected Node/cgroup wording plus redacted Kubernetes proof, then intentionally ship the fixed heap cap in the shared manifest.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the Kubernetes install surface that sallyom introduced, with adjacent input from the Fly/container precedent owners.
